text: Use an immediately available free ATS checker as the primary acquisition wedge because people searching for a free tool want to use it right away.
Publish useful and original template and role pages that help users rather than generating many pages primarily to manipulate search rankings.
Use helpful free scorecards and original aggregate analysis to generate organic traffic, inbound links, and leads.
Community acquisition should post authentic content, provide more than a link, encourage discussion, and optimize for audience enjoyment.
Career centers and coaches are credible distribution partners because universities already partner with virtual resume assistants and provide free resume scans.
Measure activation and early value before monetization because strong early activation is associated with stronger retention and standout product-led companies track activation.
Run pricing as a controlled experiment and measure sign-ups, average revenue per user, and retention while surveying customers about willingness to pay.
Defer a Chrome extension and platform integrations until the core product proves repeated use because these channels require accurate listings, useful integrations, and ongoing reliability.
